name: m18-18.4-linux
title: Lab 18.4, part 2: EU AI Act triage and the hiring what-if, audit the team's first draft (evidence, register, coverage), open the files behind the findings, crosswalk, a DRAFT pack and a tampered file, then start your own assessment: fix the greeting, mark and index C24, write the Article 50 row, check, crosswalk, tests and the challenge

steps.label: Tamper
steps.type: echo 'R99,added after the review' >> out/evidence-pack-tsg-helpdesk-2026-10-24-DRAFT/RISK-REGISTER.md && python3 govlab.py verify-pack out/evidence-pack-tsg-helpdesk-2026-10-24-DRAFT

steps.label: Fix greeting
steps.type: sed -i 's/Hello, welcome to TSG Shop support./Hello, I am the TSG Shop AI assistant, an automated system. Ask for a person at any time./' my-assessment/chat-widget.html && grep -n 'id="greeting"' my-assessment/chat-widget.html

steps.label: Index it
steps.type: echo 'E23,C24,my-assessment/chat-widget.html,,2026-10-24,Head of Customer Support,live greeting text' >> my-assessment/evidence-index.csv

steps.label: First row
steps.type: echo 'R12,People are not told they are chatting with an AI,RS12,,Human-AI Configuration,Head of Customer Support,3,2,mitigate,C24,1,1,,2027-01-24,likelihood 3: every EU chat until 24 Oct' >> my-assessment/risk-register.csv
